title: AgentCapabilityConsumer.v1
description: An AI AGENT registered as a CUSTOMER of the Teleon Agent Capability Gateway. MCP connects agents to tools; Teleon turns tools into governed, deterministic CapabilityTasks the agent calls instead of burning frontier tokens re-solving repeatable workflows. This is the consumer's BOUNDARY declaration: which capabilities it may call (allowed_capabilities), which tools are denied (forbidden_tools), the boundary_policy that governs what it can reach, and a secret_policy that carries secret REFERENCES only (env://<NAME>) — NEVER secret values. Law: agents ASK, Teleon EXECUTES, Baltor governs truth; a consumer can never self-expand its own boundary (that requires an AgentBoundaryExpansionRequest held for human approval) and an agent/LLM output is never served truth.

consumer_id.description: stable id of the agent consumer (the customer calling the gateway)

kind.description: the class of agent consumer; OpenClaw/Hermes/OpenHands-style runtimes are CANDIDATES, never executed here — this only classifies the calling customer

allowed_capabilities.description: explicit allowlist of capability_ids this consumer may call (deny-by-default — a capability not listed cannot be invoked)

forbidden_tools.description: explicit tool denylist; a tool here is rejected even if a capability would otherwise reach it

boundary_policy.description: the consumer's boundary governance object (e.g. {can_self_expand: false, requires_human_for_boundary_change: true, max_cost_per_run, allowed_domains}) — the agent cannot self-expand purpose/secrets/domains; widening the boundary requires an AgentBoundaryExpansionRequest held for human approval

secret_policy.description: secret REFERENCES only (e.g. {refs: ["env://<NAME>"]}) — NEVER secret values; resolved only at the runtime boundary by an authorized resolver, never exposed to the agent
